title: Close the periodontal chart
summary: Patient report, billing, next visit, notes and signature.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide goes on when their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient.

steps.title: Periodontal chart
steps.details: Opens a new periodontal chart: missing teeth, pontics and implants come from the latest odontogram, and the latest closed chart is the guide.

steps.title: Closing
steps.details: What is needed to sign, on one screen.

steps.title: Patient report
steps.details: A plain-words summary of how their gums are and what to do.

steps.title: WhatsApp, Print or Send
steps.details: By WhatsApp, printed with both arches or by email. Sending it is recorded.

steps.title: Today's billing
steps.details: Charge opens the billing wizard; the invoice is linked and shows here with its payments. Or “Nothing to charge today”.

steps.title: Next visit
steps.details: Book on the suggested date, or Schedule later (the maintenance reminder uses it).

steps.title: Session notes
steps.details: Free text of the periodontal chart.

steps.title: What is missing to sign
steps.details: Probing, diagnosis, billing, next visit and confirmed dictation. Tap what is pending to settle it.

steps.title: Sign and close
steps.details: With everything settled, sign: it becomes read-only and changes are added as amendments.
